productIntent: A compact, replayable Arcade demo that feels complete on the web without reproducing the full mobile game.

donor.note: Web preview must remain a derivative sealed cartridge; do not publish the entire standalone/player release package.

qualification.purpose: Prove runtime fidelity, isolation, controls, host bridge, and package integrity before adding demo progression.
qualification.note: The existing Toadal-only profile is a qualification stage, not the final web-demo product.

gameplay.calibrationRule: Ship the natural Standard Arcade end condition first. Measure bounded playtest duration. Add a hard cap only if normal preview runs consistently exceed the intended short-session target.

unlockDesign.philosophy: Give the first reward quickly, then provide a skill-or-persistence path to the third character so the demo never becomes a grind wall.
unlockDesign.classic: Unlock after the player's first completed run.
unlockDesign.gully: Unlock at 600 best score OR after 3 completed runs, whichever happens first.
unlockDesign.note: Gully is character id 'pelican' in the runtime. Web-preview entitlement must not alter his mobile coinCost or the mobile save economy.

identity.headline: Limited browser preview
identity.conversionMessage: Play the Arcade preview here, unlock the three-character web roster, then continue with the full TOADAL FEAST adventure.

storage.bridgeRule: Opaque-origin cartridge receives only explicit preview state through toadal.game.v1. Do not add allow-same-origin merely for save access.

runtimeEntitlementBridge.purpose: Allow the web-preview roster to use normal Arcade character implementations without changing mobile pricing/unlock rules.
runtimeEntitlementBridge.rule: Host sends the web-preview unlocked character IDs. The cartridge adapter may seed equivalent in-memory runtime ownership only for the current preview session before selecting a character.
forbidden: writing preview unlocks into the mobile froggyFeast save
exposing arbitrary parent localStorage to the cartridge

mandatoryFamilies: Arcade runtime food actually reachable by the selected profile
hazard/pickup assets actually reachable by the selected profile
power-up assets actually reachable by the selected profile
shared Arcade runtime/scripts/styles required by Standard mode
excludeFamilies: non-preview playable character animation families unless runtime proves unavoidable
shop/cosmetics/daily-goal presentation assets not required by gameplay
raw source/master art not needed at runtime
optimizationOrder: qualify intact Standard Arcade runtime first

acceptance: real Standard Arcade run starts and completes with Toadal
Classic Frog unlocks after first completed run
Gully unlocks at 600 best score or 3 completed runs
all three web characters can start a real run through normal character behavior
web unlocks do not change canonical mobile coin costs or mobile save data
best score/unlocks persist through website-owned isolated storage when persistence is enabled
opaque-origin cartridge cannot access unrelated website/account/session storage
results screen celebrates score/unlocks before conversion CTA
full-game CTA becomes prominent only after meaningful engagement or web-roster completion
